description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

B4Corp is hiring a Software Engineer to support its client’s mission-focused work. The role centers on Java web application and REST API development, Linux and Tomcat administration, and secure systems involving LDAP, SSH, and PKI; it requires a TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph.
Level 1 Subject Matter Expert Software Engineer building Java web applications, secure REST APIs, and LDAP/PKI authentication tools

Requirements:
• Position Requires a Top Secret (TS/SCI) Clearance with a Polygraph
• Expert-level knowledge of Core Java (NOT Spring Boot), Eclipse IDE v2026, Java 17 or later, JVM, JRE, and JDK concepts, JavaScript, AJAX, jQuery, JSP, Apache Tomcat 11 or later, Tomcat connector, MariaDB (MySQL) v10 or latest, HTML5, CSS, JSON/XML HTTP, HTTPS, REST API, SSH, PKI, OpenSSL, Putty, Linux and LDAP
• Extensive experience with LDAP authentication and authorization, and custom LDAP-based solutions
• Strong experience with SSH and Putty, and custom SSH-based tools and applications on Linux platform
• Experience with Linux system administration and command-line tools
• Experience with Java REST API development, and API secure requests using application certificates and scalability for user activity monitoring
• Experienced with JDBC, DAO pattern and configuration using MariaDB (MySQL) and custom database tools and scripts – connection pooling without framework
• Experience deploying applications on Apache Tomcat, configuring Tomcat connectors, and managing HTTPD (Apache HTTP Server)
• Experience with front-end development with JSP, AJAX, jQuery, JavaScript, HTML and CSS design for web presence and back-end development
• Experienced writing Jakarta Servlet API, including servlet lifecycle, request and response handling, and session management
• Experience with Java Base64 API, that encodes and decodes data, including its usage and limitations
• Knowledge of Java Cryptography Architecture (JCA) and its APIs
• Knowledge of encryption algorithms, such as AES, RSA and ECC and their usage in Java
• Experience with Quartz Job Scheduling Library using Core Java development
• Experience with software version control tools (Git/GitHub) code repository
• Knowledge of PKI infrastructure and secure data transmission, and custom PKI-based tools and applications
• Knowledge of X.509 certificate handling, including certificate parsing, certificate validation and certificate chaining
• Experienced in generating, managing, and storing key pairs using OpenSSL and RSA, troubleshooting PKI-related issues, including key pair and certificate problems
• Strong problem-solving skills and analytical thinking, attention to detail, and excellent communication and collaboration skills with technical and non-technical stakeholders
• Ability to analyze user needs to determine technical requirements
• Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code
• Shows initiative and offers ideas for new products and improvements to existing interfaces
• Actively keeps apprised of industry technological enhancements and changes

Preferred:
• Some experience integrating Python into web applications
• Some experience writing Confluence plugins
• Familiarity with Windows Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS) for issuing and managing Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) certificates
